{{Quote|There's a ''war'' coming, and our ''benefactor'' wants to make sure the ''right'' side gets a headstart. Our target is the ''Chancellor'' himself&mdash;''Palpatine''&hellip; And no one on ''Coruscant'' can stop us!|[[Kelsara Llenkch]]|<ref name="Too Many Cooks" />}}
At some point before [[23 BBY/Legends|13:2:28]] [[Great ReSynchronization|GRS]], the newly founded [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] led by the self-defrocked [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] plotted to '''assassinate''' [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], then [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In order to do so, the Confederacy fomented a mission involving a group of five [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], including the famed [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kelsara Llenkch]]. The Separatist-aligned agents were supposed to murder the Chancellor inside the [[Naboo Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which the Chancellor was to visit. However, their mission failed when [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who acted as the [[Security Advisor]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], intervened and unwittingly knocked the assassins out. As a consequence, Binks was made [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], effectively becoming a [[Politics/Legends|political]] ally of Palpatine.

==Background==
{{Quote|The Republic cannot be fixed, M'Lady. It is time to start over.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Dooku_and_Sidious.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] were the architects of a [[Clone Wars/Legends|conflict]] in [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|gestation]].]]
Shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Subjugation of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]], chose to leave the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="SWDP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], after [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of secret plotting with his new master, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], Dooku declared his intentions to form the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a group of disenfranchised organizations and governments the goal of which was to secede from the dominant [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="NEC" /> Unbeknownst to the immense majority of the [[galactic community]], both sides were led by the same person, as Sidious was none other than Palpatine, then [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic.<ref name="SWEsid">{{SWE|characters|darthsidious|Darth Sidious}}</ref> The purpose of the Clone Wars was to pave the way for Sidious to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destroy]] the Jedi Order and claim control over the galaxy, completing the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Sith Grand Plan]] and transforming the Republic into his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWDP" /> During the next two years, tension kept [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|mounting]] between the Republic and the Separatists, and the imminence of an armed conflict was becoming more evident.<ref name="Too Many Cooks" />

==The assassination attempt==
{{Quote|Get that control terminal off him before he gets us all ''killed''!|[[Kelsara Llenkch]]|<ref name="Too Many Cooks" />}}
[[File:Binks_saves_Typho.png|thumb|250px|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] accidentally saved [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho's]] life.]]
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], about one year after the foundation of their movement,<ref name="Timeline" /> the Separatists decided to murder the Supreme Chancellor in order to weaken the Republic and start out with an advantage in case of war. For that delicate mission, the Confederacy recruited a group of five [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]: the dreaded [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kelsara Llenkch]], two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] named [[Maash]] and [[Vela (mercenary)|Vela]], a [[Unidentified Yuzzem assassin|member]] of the [[Yuzzem]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and [[Unidentified Human assassin (CIS)|another Human]]. Their plan was to infiltrate the [[Naboo Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the Republic, which the Chancellor was meant to visit on the occasion of a grand banquet.<ref name="Too Many Cooks" />

The mercenaries easily made their way throughout the critically important [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], escaping the vigilance of the [[Color/Legends|blue]]-clad [[Senate Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]],<ref name="Chancellor Safe">[[Star Wars Comic 7.4|''Star Wars'' Comic 7.4]]</ref> and met in the vicinity of the embassy, where Llenkch informed her associates of the identity of their target. The would-be assassins then stormed the embassy's kitchen and killed the staff. The Separatists killers, all dressed as [[Chef/Legends|chefs]], with the exception of Llenkch herself and the Yuzzem, in a manner as to go undetected. However, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] hero [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]&mdash;who worked as the embassy's [[Security Advisor]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]]&mdash;overheard a conversation between Maash and Vela, who were staying in the kitchen waiting for orders.<ref name="Too Many Cooks" />

Binks immediately ran to the Grand Hall, where he bumped into Captain Typho, knocking him unconscious and unwittingly saving him from a sniper shot. With Typho incapictated, Binks seized a controlling box that allowed to summon [[Remote/Legends|sentinel droids]]. Although the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] gave him a temporary advantage, Binks could not control them correctly, and he soon found himself under the threat of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. When he was ordered to hand over the controlling box, Binks accidentally dropped it, prompting the sentinel droids to fall on his assailants' heads. Fortuitously, the clumsiness of the Security Advisor had knocked the Separatist assassins unconscious and saved the day. Palpatine, whom the would-be assassins had not even been able to reach, later showed up to thank the Gungan for his bravery and "unique abilities."<ref name="Too Many Cooks" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|At the time of writing, Binks was reportedly punching the air with joy and shouting, "Tanken yous berry much!"|[[Tho-Masfran Ciss]]|<ref name="Chancellor Safe" />}}
[[File:Jarjaraotc_copy.jpg|thumb|left|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was appointed [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] as a reward.]]
Llenkch and her accomplices were arrested and put in the custody of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. The events of the assassination attempt were recounted by [[Tho-Masfran Ciss]], [[Senior Coruscant Correspondent]] for ''[[The Coruscant Holo Net]]'', who taxed the Coruscant Guards with incompetence for not stopping the assassin before they reached the embassy.<ref name="Chancellor Safe" /> Knowing that the Gungan had developed a naive fascination for [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and had already served as the [[Gungan Ambassador]] to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="FF54">{{FactFile|54|JAR 9-10|Jar Jar Binks}}</ref> Palpatine nominated Security Advisor Binks to the position of [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as a reward for the role he played in foiling the assassination attempt.<ref name="Too Many Cooks" />

That nomination was later found to be instrumental to Palpatine's rise to unlimited power. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Palpatine convinced the Gungan of the necessity to create a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to defend the Republic against the Separatists. When Binks was asked to act in the stead of his senior [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], he suggested that the Senate give Palpatine the emergency powers required to create that army. Shortly after, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="AOC">{{Film|II}}</ref>
